behaviors: Read all source branches and all eight reference tests. Matched cold/stale answer shape, ten-second session/peer probe bounds, missing/malformed provider evidence as a blocker, thirty-second production sampling, demand-triggered sampling and the fifteen-minute last-ask cutoff.

Traced actual routing before adding the hub-only fallback: sessions::install installs no sessions handler without an engine; Core prefers explicit handlers then registered providers; Watcher never serves sessions.snapshots. NativeSources now uses a private internal service client for the literal sessions.snapshots method when no owned engine exists, retaining the original registered-provider seam without recursively asking fleet.quiescence.

Matched infrastructure exclusion, per-connection request sequence self-exclusion, later activity reactivation regardless of wall-clock resolution, and pruning disappeared connection IDs. The private fallback connection is infrastructure and cannot keep its own machine busy.

Matched job schedule evidence and advisory shell exemption; federated peers are sampled only for sessions, never recursively for their own quiescence. Disconnected, timed-out or malformed peers remain unknown blockers. Owned launch preparation, workflow reservations, terminal uncertainty and replacement operations remain additional conservative blockers.

Manager review on 2026-09-29 passed full library 311, jobs 8 and quiescence 3 (322 tests; /tmp/workspacer-jobs-manager-audit.log). Four real WebSocket/broker/provider/Watcher test groups exercise source sampling rather than replacing the fleet.quiescence handler with a stub; the handler delegates to the actual Watcher.answer.
intentionalChanges: Private in-process service connection provenance replaces the Go loopback nonce URL and random-key helper. The broker owns that identity; a wire parameter cannot claim it. Embedded session reads remain typed and include canonical retained rows, while hub-only deployments preserve registered-provider reads.
Rust rejects nonempty fleet.quiescence parameters instead of ignoring them, so callers cannot supply evidence or tune dwell. A test asserts this refusal through the actual WebSocket handler.

The owned sampler cancels in-flight reads on shutdown and bounds the complete concurrent read to twelve seconds, while each session/peer call retains its ten-second budget. A backwards clock observation fails closed. These strengthen unknown-state handling and do not authorize power actions.

behaviors: TestWatcherReadsTheFleetOverTheBus, TestWatcherBlocksOnASpawningSession and TestWatcherBlocksWhenNoProviderAnswers map to watcher_reads_registered_provider_and_refuses_unknown_or_unavailable_fleet. A real registered provider supplies responding/unknown rows over the broker; absent and malformed providers refuse quiet. Unknown detail must contain both TERMINAL and SPAWNING.

TestTheHubsOwnClientIsNotAUser and TestAskingDoesNotMakeTheMachineBusy map to watcher_excludes_infrastructure_and_asks_but_counts_later_same_connection_work. Actual internal and provider connections are observed, a fresh WebSocket caller blocks, its query self-excludes, its later sessions call increments the sequence and blocks again, and disconnected query identities are pruned.

TestJobScheduleReachesThePredicate maps to watcher_job_evidence_protects_spawn_schedule_but_exempts_advisory_shell_poller. Source evidence contains two jobs due in two minutes; the spawn job blocks and the shell poller never appears as a blocker.

TestFleetQuiescenceAnswersOverTheBus and TestTheSamplerOnlyRunsWhileSomebodyIsAsking map to watcher_wire_answer_is_cold_stale_and_sampler_runs_only_during_demand. The real wire answer preserves false/null/stale-sample/positive-dwell fields. Actual source read counts stay zero before demand, start after asking, remain eligible at five minutes and the exact fifteen-minute boundary, stop after expiry, and restart on a fresh ask.

Validation: all four watcher composites passed in the manager review full library 311 checkpoint on 2026-09-29, with jobs 8 and quiescence 3 also passing (322 tests; /tmp/workspacer-jobs-manager-audit.log). The portable monitor corpus separately pins continuous dwell, busy reset and stale-sample semantics. No real machine stop or cloud action runs in these tests.
intentionalChanges: Injectable clock and short interval are limited to exercising the real sampler loop; production continues to use UTC now, a thirty-second interval, fifteen-minute demand expiry and ten-second provider reads. The real broker and WebSocket serialization remain in the test path.
